The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 ff3098c8faf29685), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 33. statement: Suppose a smooth polarized rotation exterior has one asymptotically flat end, a compact weakly future trapped boundary, and the topology and potential regularity of the axial construction. Assume g − δ = O2(r−1), k = O1(r−3), |s| + |DX|g = O(r−2), Rg = O(r−3−δ) for some 0 < δ < 1, and finite ADM energy. The potentials have the axis and end regularity in Lemma 3.3. On each signed axis tube, s1, s2 are smooth odd functions of order y, and s3 is smooth even of order y2, with smooth longitudinal derivatives. For each row, the functions |Di|2 g, s2 i and the covector siDi extend smoothly to the three-dimensional exterior through the axis. The source expressions below use these extensions at axis points; neither an individual normalized row nor its ordinary norm is required to extend smoothly. Suppose, at every point and for every w ∈ TΩ with |w|g ≤ 1, that 8π µ + Jcon(w)  ≥ |DX|2 g + |s|2 + 2s · DX(w). (6.1) Let L > 0 be a lower bound for all crossing lengths in the meridional area metric of g. For each admissible subextremal model radius R, with F∗(R) and b = b(R) > 0 as in Lemma 3.7, Eg ≥ F∗(R) + b 2 log L 2R2 . (6.2)
